    Local endomorphism rings of finite-dimensional indecomposable modules #

    Fitting decomposition shows that every endomorphism of a finite-dimensional indecomposable module is either invertible or nilpotent. Consequently its endomorphism ring is local. The result is then transported through the fully faithful inclusion of finitely generated modules into all modules.

    The file also records a ring-level form: a finite-dimensional algebra with no nontrivial idempotents is local. This follows by applying Fitting's lemma to its right regular module.
